facebook.content:
Family—strengthening the bonds the Lord has ordained.  
In a world that pulls hearts apart, we declare divine unity and love over every household.  

Lord, we command Your peace to reign in every marriage, parent‑child relationship, and sibling tie. May Your Spirit knit us together, granting wisdom, forgiveness, and a holy legacy that honors Your name.  

Drop a 🙏 if you stand with us, or share your own request below.

instagram.content:
Family—Guard the hearth of your home.  
In the midst of daily hustle, the Lord calls us to be anchors of peace and righteousness.  

Father, we declare Your presence over every household. May love reign, disputes dissolve, and Your Spirit unify each heart. The walls of our homes stand firm on Your promise.  

Drop a 🙏 if you stand in agreement, or share your prayer need below.
